description: Insider buys and sells from SEC Form 4 at US companies ~$1B+. Buys: open-market purchases (code P, $250K+; excludes private placements, IPO allocations, ESPP, DRIP), cluster buying flagged. Sells: open-market sales (code S, $1M+) with Rule 10b5-1 plan flag and plan adoption date. Each trade also carries insider_type: routine (traded the stock in the same calendar month in each of the past 3 years), opportunistic (traded every year, no such pattern) or not_enough_history, with the evidence; method of Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski (Journal of Finance, 2012), where opportunistic trades predicted returns and routine ones did not. Default: buys, last 30 days.
name: get_insider_trades
title: Insider trades (Form 4)
